summary: Cryptocurrency exchange offering spot and derivatives trading, account and wallet data through an API.
access_note: API keys created in Account > API Management after a deposit, 2FA and identity verification; signed requests use HMAC, RSA or Ed25519.
blocker_note: Account must be funded, 2FA-enabled and identity-verified before keys can be created; availability varies by region.

evidence.quote: We support HMAC, RSA, and Ed25519 keys.
you need to make a deposit of any amount to your Spot Account to activate your account
